title: W1 — webapp: expose the shipping reader_lex route in /api/ocr (route=lex)
desc: Follow-up to merged #60 (t-20261013-c395). Finding while benching the latency receipt: the webapp /api/ocr runs T.recognise (typer path, inherited from the S4 demo), but the SHIPPING bench route is baseline.read_text + lex_projection.fix_line (reader_lex, 73/21 with 3x receipts). Measured difference on easy seed 42: baseline 'SwiR hJnnel Hdge 6int otter' vs typer 'SwR kHHo1 HdQo HHt oHou' — different functions, different reads. Carlo's demo should show shipping-route quality. Scope: (1) /api/ocr route param: 'typer' (default, unchanged) | 'lex' = baseline.read_text(img, None) + fix_line, response carries text_raw pre-projection + route; (2) UI selector + history column; (3) tests for the lex route shape + text==fix_line(text_raw); (4) latency receipt re-run including lex route (expect bench-class seconds, under the 10s bar); (5) docs. Additive, no reader change.
